description.en: End-to-end independent performance of POEM — from case selection through preprocedure preparation, esophageal cleansing, mucosotomy, submucosal tunneling, myotomy, mucosal closure and postoperative care — to a standard a supervisor can entrust without direct oversight.

label.en: Act under proactive supervision — supervisor in room and engaged
Act under reactive supervision — supervisor immediately available
May supervise others performing this EPA

provenance.reason: Forward-design EPA bundling the 12 Evideris-derived POEM competencies into an entrustable unit of independent practice. ESGE POEM 2025 Part II does not define a 20-case or 12-month threshold for independent entrustment, so no such threshold is encoded here.
